IBEX 700H: Evac+Chair Tran-Seat Transport Chair for Stairs
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/evac-chair-ibex-700h-tran-seat-patient-stair-evacuation-seat
Manufacturer page: https://www.evac-chair.com/evacuation-chairs/evacchair-700h/
Spec sheet: 700H data sheet
Keywords (Ricky's sheet): Primary: transport chair for stairs (80/mo). Secondary: patient transport chair (90), patient transfer chair stairs (0), stair evacuation seat (0), patient stair evacuation seat (0), ibex evacuation chair (0). Ricky's note: product name terms have no volume; keep them in the title and H1, target the transport chair terms in body copy.
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Evac+Chair IBEX Tran-Seat Patient Stair Evacuation Seat – 700H
Current H1: Evac+Chair IBEX 700H Tran-Seat Patient Stair Evacuation Seat
Subtitle: Two-Person Transport Chair for Stairs, Up and Down Spiral and Tight Stairways, for Patient Transport and Emergency Evacuation
Current subtitle: Evac+Chair 1-700H - IBEX 700H Tran-Seat Patient Stair Evacuation Seat
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Evac+Chair IBEX 700H Tran-Seat is a transport chair for stairs that lets two operators move a seated patient up or down the stairs with no carrying or heavy lifting. Designed for patients who cannot manage the stairs on their own, this patient transport chair reduces the physical demands on staff and the risk of muscle strain, hernia, and back injury, during daily transport or an emergency evacuation.
Lightweight at 32 lbs, the IBEX stair evacuation seat is ideal for spiral and tight stairways. Heavy duty stair tracks and an adjustable brake keep the descent controlled whatever the passenger's weight, and the chair folds for compact, wall mounted storage so it is ready when it is needed.
Operation: Two person operation, for travel up and down the stairs with no carrying
Telescopic Handle: Adjustable handle for comfortable and safe operator positioning with different passenger sizes
Front Guide Handles: For more controlled ascent and descent
Stair Tracks: Heavy duty, reinforced stair tracks for controlled ascent and descent on all types of stairways
Brake: Adjustable brake for controlled descent whatever the passenger weight
Stairways: Suitable for spiral and tight staircases
Frame: Stainless steel frame construction for strength and continued use
Seat: Detachable seat and backrest, easy to clean and simple to replace if damaged or worn
Passenger Safety: Adjustable waist/chest and leg belts, plus a footrest for passenger comfort
Handles: Integrated handles with no pinch points
Weight Capacity: 350 lbs
Weight: 32 lbs
Storage: Folds for compact storage and can be wall mounted
Certifications: FDA registered
Compliance: Exceeds fire safety requirements and emergency response guidelines established to support the Americans with Disabilities Act
Includes: Patient restraints (chest and foot), wall mounting brackets, and dust cover
Warranty: Lifetime manufacturer’s warranty
Available Models and Options
700H – IBEX Tran-Seat: Two-person transport chair for stairs, up and down, 350 lb capacity
[H2] Applications
The IBEX 700H patient transport chair suits facilities where staff need to move patients between floors on the stairs, especially where the stairways are narrow or spiral.
Typical applications include:
Hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and care homes, for patient transport between floors
Buildings with spiral or tight stairways, where a larger stair chair will not fit
Emergency evacuation and power outages, when the elevators cannot be used
Schools, offices, hotels, and public buildings
Explore Anchortex's Evacuation Chairs and Stretchers collection for more evacuation equipment.
[H2] Frequently Asked Questions
Can the IBEX 700H go up the stairs?
Yes. The IBEX 700H is made for both ascent and descent, so two operators can take a patient up or down the stairs without carrying them.
How many people does it take to operate?
Two. The IBEX 700H is designed for two-person operation, with a telescopic handle and front guide handles so both operators can control the chair on the stairs.
Can it be used on spiral staircases?
Yes. The compact IBEX 700H is ideal for spiral and tight stairways.
Is the IBEX 700H battery powered?
No. It is a manual transport chair for stairs. For battery powered travel up and down the stairs, Evac+Chair makes the Power 800 and Power 900.
[H2] About Evac+Chair Evacuation Chairs
Evac+Chair makes stair evacuation chairs, powered stair chairs, evacuation sleds, and accessories for moving people with limited mobility on stairs, in an emergency or every day.
The Evac+Chair line includes:
Emergency evacuation chairs: The 300H, 400H, 600H, and 750H stair evacuation chairs for controlled travel down the stairs
Powered stair climbing chairs: The battery powered Power 800 and Power 900 for going up and down the stairs
Stair transport seat: The IBEX 700H Tran-Seat for two-person transport up and down the stairs
Evacuation sleds and mats: The Evac+Sled, Ulti-Mat, and Evac+Sheet rescue sheet
Accessories: Comfy Seat, transfer seat, storage cabinets, anti-theft alarms, and the iEvac smoke and fire escape hood
[H2] About Evac+Chair
Evac+Chair has made stairway evacuation chairs since 1982, and its chairs were designed in the United States. Explore the full line of Evac+Chair evacuation chairs at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Keywords: as Ricky noted, the product name terms (IBEX, Tran-Seat, patient stair evacuation seat) stay in the H1 and meta title. The primary keyword "transport chair for stairs" is in the subtitle, the first sentence, a FAQ, the meta title, and the meta description, and "patient transport chair" is in the intro. The search results for "transport chair for stairs" are stair chair product pages (Stryker, Ferno, EZ-LITE), so the term fits. None of the competitors that sell the 700H (School Health, Med Mart, Health Products For You) use it in their titles.
FOLDED SIZE: the 700H data sheet (July 2024) and our page say 43" high; the Evac+Chair web page and School Health say 41"; Health Products For You says 45" x 16". I left the folded size out until you confirm. I suggest 43"H x 18"W x 14"D from the data sheet.
Stair size: the data sheet shows "16" Min" and "20 to 40°" under Staircase Type and Important Dimensions, but the layout does not say which is which (likely a 16" minimum stair width and a 20 to 40° stair angle). Should I add these? They would answer "Will it fit my stairs?"
Name: Evac+Chair now calls it the "Evac+Chair 700H" (web page and data sheet), with "IBEX Tran-Seat" as the description. Our subtitle says "1-700H". I kept IBEX Tran-Seat in the H1 because Ricky asked for the product name terms there, and retailers search and list it as IBEX.
Removed "Instructional DVD" from Includes: it is on our page but not on the Evac+Chair page or the data sheet. Is a DVD still included?
Operators: Health Products For You says it needs only one operator. Evac+Chair says two, so I used two and added a FAQ.
Ascent: a buyer on Health Products For You asked whether the chair goes up as well as down, and it was never answered. I added "Can the IBEX 700H go up the stairs?" as a FAQ.
Shipping weight: the variant is set to 200 lbs. The chair weighs 32 lbs. Is 200 lbs the boxed weight?
Price: $2,695 with compare-at $3,593 (75%, not 80%). Competitors: Med Mart $3,161, Health Products For You $3,153.89, School Health $3,596.99, so we are the lowest. No change made.
Added from the data sheet: heavy duty reinforced stair tracks (not on our current page).
Left out: "Successful in saving lives in 9/11" and "World's No.1" claims from the data sheet, and School Health's claim that the track carries about 90% of the passenger's weight (not from Evac+Chair).
Removed from the About section: "the original Emergency Evacuation Staircase Chair" and "Ask about their lifetime warranty" (the warranty is now a bullet).
Current meta description is a general GSA pricing line. Is GSA pricing still offered?
Images: the page has only one image. Would you like me to add 700H photos from the Evac+Chair website?
